description: Find the nearest available dates when requested dates are not available. Searches for alternative check-in dates within a specified window and can adjust length of stay.

maxLengthOfStay.description: Maximum length of stay in days (optional)

minLengthOfStay.description: Minimum length of stay in days

preferredCheckIn.description: Preferred check-in date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD)

searchWindowDays.description: Number of days before and after preferred date to search (default: 90)

stayId.description: The unique identifier of the stay

name: findNearestAvailability
